title: Pyramid Analytics B.V.
description:
[analytics] Pyramid Analytics B.V. — a decision-intelligence platform company headquartered in Amsterdam, acquired by ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) for hundreds of millions of dollars just four months earlier.

We obtained the complete source code of the Pyramid Decision Intelligence Platform along with:

10+ copies of the platform source code with full Git history, revealing every feature, algorithm, security module, and AI integration ever built.
<censored>
<censored>
22 GB of SQL Server production database backups likely containing user accounts, credentials, and business data.
Customer data from publicly traded companies — Shufersal (TASE: SAE) retail sales data and ABB (NYSE: ABB) OLAP cube backups.
